name: Ellmi's Zauberwelt Hartkaiser Ellmau
kurzbeschreibung: Ellmi's Zauberwelt at the Hartkaiser in Ellmau at 1,555 m: 4,000 m² nature adventure park with enchanted forest, climbing castle, and panoramic views of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular nature and children's adventure park Ellmi's Zauberwelt is located on the 1,555-metre-high summit plateau of the Hartkaiser above the renowned holiday village of Ellmau in the Tyrolean Unterland (Kufstein district). Nestled in open larch and Swiss stone pine forests right by the mountain station of the modern Hartkaiserbahn cable car, this lovingly designed open-air site spans approximately 4,000 square metres. With its incomparable view of the sheer rock faces of the Wilder Kaiser, the magical realm of “Ellmi” the magic frog is regarded as one of the most popular family destinations in the entire Alpine region.

Route & Requirements

The adventure park is themed around the mythical legend of Ellmi, a peasant boy who was transformed into a magic frog by mountain goblins. Equipped with a colourful treasure map and a riddle app, children and parents set off on an adventurous journey of discovery along winding forest trails. Highlights of the park include the monumental wooden climbing castle with tube slides, the interactive goblin maze, an adventurous water play area with locks and rafts, and the large wooden marble run. Along the Naturlehrpfad Rübezahl nature trail, informative display boards and audio stations share insights into local flora and fauna, the secrets of the alpine mountain forest, and rare mushroom and medicinal herb species. For relaxation, spacious panoramic loungers and quiet zones offer unobstructed views of the Wilder Kaiser, the Kitzbüheler Horn, and the Loferer Steinberge. The modern panoramic restaurant Bergkaiser at the mountain station serves regional Tyrolean cuisine on a sun-drenched terrace.

Visit & Arrival

Ellmi's Zauberwelt is open daily during the summer season from mid-May to late October from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to the nature adventure park is free; visitors only require a cable car ticket for the Hartkaiserbahn. Summer 2025/2026 fares (ascent and descent): adults approx. €31.00, youth (born 2007–2009) approx. €23.50, children (born 2010–2019) approx. €15.50, children under 6 ride free. Holders of the regional Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card use the cable car free of charge. By car: via the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Kufstein Süd), continue on the B178 (Loferer Straße) for about 15 km directly to Ellmau; large free parking is available at the Hartkaiserbahn valley station (Weißachgraben 5). By public transport: train to St. Johann in Tirol or Kufstein station, then take the VVT bus line 4060 every half hour directly to the Ellmau Hartkaiserbahn stop.

Tips

The 10-seater gondolas of the Hartkaiserbahn, the mountain restaurant, and the main trails of the enchanted forest feature step-free accessibility and are well suited for wheelchairs and pushchairs. Children receive a free magic riddle booklet at the valley station; solving the clues earns them a surprise gift at the ticket counter when leaving. Combine your visit with an easy panoramic hike from the Hartkaiser to the nearby Rübezahl-Alm mountain inn.
